subject: Request: short extension & small credits to cover integration backfill
messages:
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@brightledger.co>
To: irene.choi@redwood.ai
Cc: dev@brightledger.co
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short extension + credits to cover integration backfill

Hi Irene,

Quick note from our side — we hit an unexpected blocker during the adapter phase. Our payments schema changed in mid-July and the adapter the team built needs a non-trivial mapping update (we discovered this in staging yesterday). Engineers are heads down but estimate ~8 business days to finish and validate.

We're deep in the pilot (DL-3491) and the demo window is scheduled for next Thursday. Given the gap, we wanted to ask if Redwood can: 1) extend our pilot access by two weeks, and 2) provide a small top-up of sandbox credits so we can run a few additional end-to-end regressions (we burned most of the initial credits on environment debugging).

I attached the integration log and a short SOW diff that highlights the schema changes. We'd be grateful for whatever runway you can provide — a priority for us is keeping the demo meaningful for stakeholders next week.

Two quick questions:
- Is a two-week extension something you can approve from your side?
- Any chance of a small one-off sandbox credit grant to help with the E2E regression cycles?

Thanks,
Sanjay
Senior Product Manager
BrightLedger

Attachment: integration-log-20270819.txt (text/plain)
Attachment: sow-diff.pdf (application/pdf)

From: irene.choi@redwood.ai <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@brightledger.co>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short extension + credits to cover integration backfill

Hi Sanjay — thanks for the detail and for sending the logs. I pulled the team in and sketched a couple options.

Short answer: we can help. Details below and a couple of asks so we align on next steps.

What we can do now
- Pilot extension: we can extend the sandbox access for +14 calendar days.
- Credits: we can grant a one-time 500k token sandbox top-up (applied to the BrightLedger pilot environment).

What we need from you to finalize
1) Confirm the new demo date you want us to treat as the end of the pilot.
2) Approve the proposed credit amount (500k tokens) or suggest a different number.
3) If you want us to run a smoke test after the adapter change, let us know a target window and we can schedule an engineer to standby.

Ben (cc'd) will confirm the credit approval path; Marissa, our CS lead, can coordinate the smoke test.

If that works I'll process the extension and credits today so you get the buffer right away.

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai

Irene — fine with the +14 days and the 500k token bump. Approving now.

Two small notes for ops:
- Mark the top-up as a pilot grant (non-recurring) against deal DL-3491 and tag it so finance can reconcile.
- Make sure the sandbox top-up is active immediately and that their API keys won't expire during the new window.

Marissa, can you coordinate a smoke test on Monday morning PT? If BrightLedger wants Redwood to kick off the regression, schedule a 2-hour slot and let me know if we need to pull an engineer from runtime.

Ben Carter
VP, Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
